permission_urls.statement: Clause 113: API may be used "in personal and commercial integrations"; apply via applicationLink, link back, no passing jobs to Google Jobs/LinkedIn/aggregators (incl. JobPosting schema).
Public API docs; free key gives 60 req/min, 10,000/day.

Free API "can be used in commercial projects"; may "store, cache, process, and redistribute". "Clearly credit Jobicy as the original source" with a direct link; apply links go to the original job page on Jobicy; start an automated sync pass "no more than once per hour".
robots.txt does not disallow /api/ (only the /search?... HTML pages); site signals "Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no". The search API is undocumented; no formal licence text.
Workable's rule for its job data: keep job URLs unchanged (candidate attribution).
"legal" field in API response: link back (follow, no nofollow) and mention Remote OK as source; no logo without written permission.
